classification: exact finite synthetic population identification; no apparatus data
inverse_rule: c=m_corners; theta_z=(m_cc-phi(z).c)/b(z); independently reconstruct means and integrate target
position_rule: one fixed unknown position per run, declared finite menu, no prior or per-shot mixing
set_rule: retain menu-ordered admitted position/coefficient/target triples; sorted distinct targets separately; status infeasible/identified/ambiguous by zero/one/multiple targets
hull_rule: null for infeasible; otherwise minimum, maximum and width; never equate interval hull with exact finite set
gap_probe_rule: null for fewer than two distinct targets; otherwise midpoint of first two sorted distinct targets, which is outside the exact finite set
disclosure_rule: per candidate, exact position disclosure yields its target iff admitted; otherwise infeasible with null target

domain_control.rule: f=1-16*b is globally in [0,1] but outside the sufficient class; domain refusal is not physical invalidity

public_boundary: exact five role-labeled population means and declared menu only; no origin position, private coefficients, position-specific preparation tag or actual-position prior; no new acquisition API
comparison: complete native type-exact independent reports; selected BF six-position geometry and four center-profile full laws only; no historical numerical execution
no_claims: globally valid rejected profiles in general
